recommendation: Resolve all three findings and re-review exact revised bytes before WBS build.

findings.claim: The charge protocol makes its preflight P3/index snapshot unsatisfiable: it aggregates current P1-P16/P14 before creating the intent and appending OPEN, then permits differences from every preflight member only for invalidation, RootControlJournal, and AdministrativeResourceLedger prefixes, not for the TransitionIntentIndex that OPEN necessarily changes.
findings.disposition_reason: Confirmed preflight exception omits the required one-OPEN index extension.

findings.claim: Acceptance-projection mismatch has incompatible mandatory dispositions: Section 5.4 permits repair from invalid persisted bytes to ACCEPTED or REJECTED_CHARGED, while the uniform Section 9.1 protocol covering every acceptance write requires a neither-source-nor-candidate, strict-invalid, or partial current ledger to exit only through terminal FAILED_CHARGED_PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN recovery.
findings.disposition_reason: Confirmed acceptance repair conflicts with uniform divergent recovery.

findings.claim: The only completion-corruption recovery is defined for a charged APPLIED path and requires an original guarded receipt, attempt, and charge, but the design also permits a pre-charge NOT_APPLIED completion to become partial or differing and promises HUMAN recovery; that uncharged case has no executable recovery contract.
findings.disposition_reason: Confirmed corrupt pre-charge NOT_APPLIED completion lacks recovery.

residual_risks: Index transition and recovery semantics remain incomplete.
